title: Twin-prime parity: the complete registry and the explicit-function programme
summary: The registry and evidence of the twin-prime-parity programme: 3 objectives, 27 tasks, a 263-round log, 97 Lean modules, 38 probes. O3: the eta/Euler route to zeta on the critical line is an evaluator, not a certification. O2: a recorded negative verdict, since the harmonic tier's Egyptian decomposition has the sum as its only invariant. O1: the Route A/B/C cores are already general in Lean; the Dirichlet L instantiation is closed apart from the PNT-strength inputs hL, hH. Certified: conjugation reality, the root-number sign, a chi_3 Turing window, a conditional count. The sharp archimedean rate is verified, one lemma short.
recipe_md:
All commands are run from this folder (the one holding `objectives.json`). Python 3 with `mpmath` (and `numpy`/`sympy` for the plotting scripts). stdout carries results; progress and timing go to stderr. The heavy certificates were NOT re-run when this manuscript was written; their archived outputs in `logs/` were cited instead.

```sh
python3 verify_objectives.py                 # seconds; expect 'RESULT: OK', exit 0
cd python && python3 t12_sharp_rate_probe.py # expect sup ratio 0.5590179691, exit 0
cd python && python3 decomposition_lab_zeta_probe.py   # expect the P1-P6 numbers, exit 0

# Not re-run here (archived logs cited):
cd python && python3 check_dirichlet_engine.py         # several minutes; expect 'RESULT: PASS'
cd python && python3 certify_dirichlet_routeB.py chi_3 10 8 20 50 1 4   # ~12 min; N=1 CERTIFIED
cd python && python3 zeta_routeB.py 15 8 60            # expect N(15)=1 CERTIFIED
cd python && python3 zeta_routeB.py 33 8 100           # expect N(33)=5 CERTIFIED
cd python && python3 dirichlet_explicit.py             # 8-13 min; residuals within budget
cd python && python3 certify_count15_uncond.py         # 9571 s recorded
cd lean && ./check.sh --all                            # 97 modules; expect 97x '[check] OK', exit 0
python3 check_footprints.py /path/to/all.log --expect 365   # expect 'RESULT: all clean'
```

Prerequisites for the Lean layer: toolchain `leanprover/lean4:v4.35.0-rc2` via elan at `$LEAN_PREFIX/elan` (default `$HOME/lean/elan`) and Mathlib4 at `$LEAN_PREFIX/mathlib4`; `check.sh` exits 2 if Mathlib is absent. The three PNG figures are binary and are not attached to the published return; they stay in the folder and are cited by their relative paths.
